question: What is the value of 25 × 7 ÷ 175 - 196 ÷ 14 × 2 + 625 ÷ 25 × 3?
solution:
Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c43b324204a7eb07d4fa446d1da10f31ca0de35763144792dc8de9f689bd353.png] 

**Calculation:**

25 × 7 ÷ 175 - 196 ÷ 14 × 2 + 625 ÷ 25 × 3

⇒ 25 × 7 / 175 - 14 × 2 + 25 × 3

⇒ 1 - 28 + 75 

⇒ 76 - 28 

= 48

∴ The correct option is 1
